# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only live current version is under support.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting on this repository (**Security → Report a vulnerability**), which reaches the maintainers without disclosing the details publicly.

We will acknowledge your email within 48 hours and provide a detailed response within 7 days, including a timeline for a fix.
